why_this_direction: Resume the interrupted fixed joint experiment from its last complete persistent native checkpoint, revision 3. The failed process held its four subsequent updates in volatile state. Keep the stock loss baseline and the declared 95% endpoint.
repeating_pattern_check: Host RAM pressure coincided with a display failure while saving diagnostics. Use file-backed working weights and optimizer remainders and a headless graphics backend. Keep computation, registration, loss, and weight updates fixed; assess results from MLflow at termination.
hypothesis: A weight gradient that includes the pre-choice computational difference along with the other local divergences can accumulate the downhill and climb repairs on one stock-origin lineage.
what_went_wrong_before: Update8 installed completely, then storage reserve refused its fresh capture. The measured-state-only admission cannot label its stale measurement7 as endpoint8; a distinct recovery admission is required.
rule: One fixed reference, one freshly regenerated wrong response, all105 local position losses, full learned-parameter derivative, response-scaled single update with retained empirical eta and mixed-native remainder, joint installation, then fresh generation and remeasurement.
prediction: The same model adds 40 J to 64 J and retains 91 J after friction on the descent fit, and preserves 95 J while correcting the climb requirement to 40 J on the climb fit. The intact 44 J case keeps its downhill, friction and climb arithmetic. Evaluate all fourteen earlier fitted questions and, after fit-based endpoint selection, the sixteen frozen fresh prompts.
would_weaken_it: At the selected loss endpoint, incorrect energy operations, lost trace support, or failed transfer limit the claim. Read the freshly generated fitted and preserved results and the frozen evaluation panel only at the endpoint.
